fusion-10-bars-boutique-box.name: Fusion 10 Bars Boutique Box

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion 10 Bars Boutique Box The Fusion 10 Bars Boutique Box is a curated collection of gourmet chocolate bars that combines high-quality chocolate with psilocybin mushrooms, offering a unique indulgence for adventurous chocolate lovers. Each box contains 10 bars, featuring 10 different flavors, with each bar infused with either 4 grams or 6 grams of psilocybin mushrooms, depending on the specific product line. The flavors include popular options such as Cookies and Cream, Birthday Cake, Almond Crush, and more exotic choices like Lemon Blueberry. The bars are crafted in Los Angeles and are marketed as both a delightful treat and a means to elevate mood and enhance experiences through the effects of psilocybin. Product Details of Fusion 10 Bars Boutique Box Flavors : The Fusion 10 Bars Boutique Box offers a variety of flavors designed to cater to diverse taste preferences. Some of the flavors mentioned include: Cookies and Cream Birthday Cake Almond Crush Banana Chocolate Ferrero Rocher Strawberries and Cream Milk Chocolate Twix Thin Mint Lemon Blueberry Psilocybin Content : Each bar is infused with either 4 grams or 6 grams of psilocybin mushrooms, which are known for their mind-altering properties. This infusion aims to provide not just a flavorful experience but also potential mood-enhancing effects. Packaging : The bars come in boutique boxes containing a total of 100 bars divided into packs of 10 different flavors. This packaging is designed for both individual enjoyment and wholesale distribution. Pricing : The price for the boutique box is set at $15 per box containing the assortment of flavors, making it an attractive option for both retailers and consumers looking for quality chocolate infused with psilocybin. Wholesale Options : There are significant discounts available for bulk purchases, appealing to wholesalers who wish to stock these innovative products in their stores. Quality Assurance : The bars are made with high-quality ingredients sourced responsibly, ensuring that customers receive a product that meets both taste and safety standards. Target Audience : These chocolate bars are aimed at individuals looking for unique culinary experiences that combine gourmet chocolate with the psychoactive properties of psilocybin mushrooms. In summary, the Fusion 100 Bars Boutique Box represents an innovative approach to combining gourmet chocolate with psychedelic elements, catering to those interested in exploring new flavor profiles while potentially enhancing their mood through the effects of psilocybin mushrooms .

fusion-apple-strudel-vape.name: Fusion Apple Strudel Vape

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion Apple Strudel Vape is one of the dessert-style flavors gaining attention in the disposable vape and infused vape market because of its sweet pastry-inspired profile. Users commonly describe the flavor as: baked apple, cinnamon sugar, flaky pastry, and creamy dessert undertones. The “Apple Strudel” flavor profile itself has become very popular in vaping because it balances: sweet fruit, warm bakery notes, and smooth vapor production. Flavor Profile Fusion Apple Strudel Vape Most Apple Strudel-style vapes are described as: sweet but not overly candy-like, warm cinnamon pastry on inhale, tart apple finish on exhale, with buttery bakery undertones. Reviewers comparing Apple Strudel vape flavors often mention: “tastes like an actual apple strudel.” Another reviewer described the profile as: “sweet baked apple” with pastry notes. Reported Effects Fusion Apple Strudel Vape If this Fusion vape is cannabis-infused or live-resin based, users generally report: relaxing body effects, euphoric mood, mild uplift, and smooth daytime-to-evening use. The Apple Strudel cannabis strain itself is commonly associated with: euphoric, uplifted, relaxed, and energetic effects. Users also frequently mention: dessert aroma, sour apple candy notes, and smooth creamy vapor. What Users Like Pros Smooth dessert flavor Good apple/cinnamon balance Less harsh than fruity ice flavors Strong aroma Sweet exhale without excessive cooling Cons Can become very sweet after long sessions Dessert flavors may clog coils faster Some batches reportedly taste artificial Authenticity concerns depending on seller Best For Is usually recommended for people who enjoy: bakery-style vape flavors, warm cinnamon dessert profiles, apple pastry flavors, and smoother sweet vapor rather than icy mint styles. Flavor Comparison Flavor Element Strength Apple Strong Cinnamon Medium Pastry/Bakery Strong Sweetness Medium-High Cooling/Ice Low Creaminess Medium

fusion-bar-almond-crush.name: Fusion Bar Almond Crush

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion Bar Almond Crush Fusion Bar Almond Crush (from Fusion Mushroom Bars ) is a chocolate-based edible infused with mushroom extract or similar compounds , combined with crunchy roasted almonds for texture and flavor. 🍫 Key Features Chocolate base (milk or dark options) Roasted almond pieces for crunch Segmented squares for easier dosing Infused formula designed for gradual effects Often comes in resealable premium packaging 👉 It’s positioned as a mix between a gourmet chocolate bar and an infused edible 🌰 Flavor Profile Fusion Bar Almond Crush The Almond Crush version stands out for its sweet + nutty combo : Buttery roasted almond taste Smooth, creamy chocolate Slight earthy undertone from the infusion 👉 Many describe it as tasting more like a dessert chocolate bar than a typical edible ⚡ Effects (Important) Effects depend on what’s actually inside the bar: If functional (non-psychoactive): Mild relaxation Focus or mood support No “high” If psychoactive (psilocybin or similar): Euphoria Altered perception Relaxation or introspection 👉 Effects can take 30–90 minutes to start and may last several hours 📊 Dosing Most bars are divided into squares for control: Beginner: 1–2 pieces Moderate: 2–4 pieces Strong: 5+ pieces 👉 Full bar is not recommended for beginners ⚠️ Reality Check (Very Important) This is where you need to be careful: ❌ Unregulated Market Many Fusion bars are not officially regulated Ingredients may not always match labels ❌ Counterfeit Risk Reddit users often warn: “Anyone can buy the packaging… you don’t know what’s inside” ❌ Mixed Experiences Some users report good experiences , while others say effects felt different from real mushrooms or inconsistent ⚖️ Legal Status Functional versions: Usually legal Psychedelic versions: Illegal in most countries (including much of EU & UK) 👉 Always check your local laws before buying or using 🧠 Final Verdict Fusion Bar Almond Crush 👍 Why People Like It ✔ Great chocolate taste ✔ Crunchy almond texture ✔ Easy to dose ✔ Convenient edible format ⚠️ Downsides ❌ Quality varies a lot ❌ Risk of fake or unknown ingredients ❌ Legal concerns depending on type ✅ Bottom Line Fusion Bar Almond Crush Almond Crush is popular because it combines good flavor + convenience + effects , but it’s not something to buy blindly .

base to create a nostalgic, dessert-style edible experience. 👉 It’s inspired by the classic cinnamon toast cereal taste, blended into a modern infused chocolate format. 🍩 Flavor Profile This flavor is tasting like cinnamon toast cereal in chocolate form ⚡ Effects (Depends on Type) Like other Fusion bars, the effects depend on what’s infused: 🟢 Functional versions: Light relaxation Calm focus No psychoactive “high” 🔴 Psychoactive versions: Euphoria Relaxation Altered mood or perception 👉 Effects usually begin within 30–60 minutes and can last several hours . 📊 Dosing Guide Most bars are divided into small squares (often around 10 pieces): 1 square: mild / beginner 2–3 squares: moderate effects 4–5 squares: stronger relaxation 6+ squares: experienced users only 👉 Always start low and classic raw Cookie Dough flavor in a smooth, easy-to-consume. 👉 It combines dessert-style taste + infused ingredients in one product. 🍫 Flavor Profile Fusion Bar Cookie Dough This is one of the most popular flavors because of its rich, nostalgic taste : Sweet brown sugar & vanilla notes Soft cookie dough-like texture Chocolate chips or cocoa hints Slight earthy undertone (from infusion) 👉 Many describe it as tasting like raw cookie dough covered in chocolate 🌿 Ingredients & Blend Fusion Bar Cookie Dough Typical versions include: Chocolate base (milk or dark) Cookie dough flavoring pieces: moderate 4+ pieces: stronger effects 👉 Always start low and wait before increasing ✨ Key Features Dessert-style flavor (very beginner-friendly) Easy portion control Portable and discreet Often marketed with even dosing per square 🎯 Why People Choose ✔ Familiar, sweet taste ✔ Masks mushroom flavor well ✔ Smooth texture (less gritty) ✔ Good entry option for beginners 👉 It’s often considered Flavor Profile Fusion Bar Fruit Loops This is one of the most fun and nostalgic flavors in the Fusion lineup: Fruity cereal notes (orange, lemon, berry) Creamy white chocolate base Crunchy cereal bits in every bite Sweet vanilla finish 👉 Many describe it as tasting like “cereal milk in chocolate form” 🌿 Ingredients & Blend Typical Fusion Fruit Loops bars include: White chocolate (often Belgian-style) Fruit-flavored cereal pieces Mushroom blend such as: Lion’s Mane (focus) Reishi (calm) Cordyceps (energy) Chaga (immune support) 👉 Some versions are marketed as wellness (functional) , and vanilla flavoring Sweet cream notes (inspired by horchata drink) Mushroom blend such as: Lion’s Mane (focus) Reishi (calm) Cordyceps (energy) 👉 Some versions are functional (wellness) , while fusion-laughing-gas-gummy.name: Fusion Laughing Gas Gummy

reference.sourceFullDescription: 🎭 What is Fusion Laughing Gas Gummy Fusion Laughing Gas Gummy combines the playful creativity of the Laughing Gas brand with Fusion’s reputation for flavorful mushroom edibles. Despite the name, “Laughing Gas” does not actually contain nitrous oxide . It’s just a branding style used by some online sellers. The product is typically: A fruit-flavored gummy candy Part of a “collaboration” branding line (Fusion x Laughing Gas) Sold in different flavors like sour apple, grape, watermelon, etc. Marketed as a high-potency infused edible 🍬 Flavor + experience Common descriptions across listings include: Sweet and sour candy taste Chewy gummy texture Strong fruity flavors depending on variant Designed to mask strong infusion taste 🧠 Marketed effects (varies by seller) Depending on the version being sold , it is often promoted for: Relaxation Mood lift / euphoria Strong body effects (in high-dose versions) Long-lasting edible experience Some listings describe it as “high tolerance” or “strong potency” products. ⚠️ Important reality check The “Fusion x Laughing Gas” name is used across multiple unofficial shops, meaning: There is no single standardized formula Potency and ingredients vary widely between sellers Some products may be counterfeit or rebranded Lab verification is not consistent across listings 🧾 Simple explanation Fusion Laughing Gas Gummy The Laughing Gas i s basically : a branded infused gummy candy sold in different flavors, marketed as a strong edible, but with inconsistent formulation depending on the seller.

fusion-lavender-lemonade-gummy.name: Fusion Lavender Lemonade Gummy

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion Lavender Lemonade Gummy is a floral-citrus infused gummy designed for a calmer, more wellness-focused edible experience compared to sweeter candy-style gummies. 🌿🍋 Flavor Profile Fusion Lavender Lemonade Gummy This gummy blends: Bright lemonade citrus Soft lavender floral notes Light herbal sweetness Smooth chewy gummy texture Fusion describes the flavor as: “a spa day in a gummy.” The taste is designed to feel: refreshing calming less sugary than typical candy gummies more “wellness-style” than dessert-style 🧠 Marketed Effects Fusion Lavender Lemonade Gummy According to Fusion product descriptions, the gummies are promoted for: calm focus stress relief mood support creativity evening relaxation mindfulness and wellness routines Fusion specifically markets this flavor as ideal for: yoga meditation journaling winding down after work sleep preparation ⚡ Infusion & Onset Fusion Lavender Lemonade Gummy The gummies are advertised as using: nano-emulsified infusion technology faster absorption compared to standard edibles Fusion claims onset may begin within: 30–45 minutes depending on metabolism and dosage. 🍬 Product Features Online listings mention: 10 gummies per pouch vegan-friendly ingredients gluten-free formula dye-free ingredients lavender flower extract lemon juice concentrate 💰 Price Current online pricing is: around $20 per package 🗣️ Community Reactions Lavender-lemon flavored infused products generally get positive reactions online from users who enjoy herbal citrus flavors. One Reddit user described a lavender lemonade product as: “sweet lemons terps… calming and euphoric . ” Another said: “Lavender is so fire.” ⚠️ Important Safety Notes Many “Fusion” infused products are sold through unofficial websites and resellers, so : potency may vary packaging may be copied ingredient consistency is not always guaranteed If trying infused gummies: start with a low amount wait before taking more avoid mixing with alcohol or other substances keep away from children and pets

Fusion Nerds Chocolate Bar
Fusion Nerds Chocolate Bar is a candy-inspired mushroom chocolate edible that combines creamy chocolate with crunchy, colorful Nerds-style candy pieces for a sweet-and-tangy flavor experience.
🍬🍫 Flavor Profile Fusion Nerds Chocolate Bar
The Nerds version is designed to taste sweeter and more playful than classic chocolate bars. Users describe it as:


 	Sweet milk chocolate
 	Crunchy candy texture
 	Fruity tart candy notes
 	Colorful dessert-style flavor

The candy inspiration comes from Nerds, the crunchy sugar candy first launched in the 1980s.

🍄 What’s Inside Fusion Nerds Chocolate Bar
Fusion bars are marketed as mushroom-infused edibles. Depending on the seller, they may contain:


 	Functional mushrooms
 	Psilocybin mushroom blends
 	Botanical or synthetic psychoactive compounds

Ingredient transparency varies significantly across websites and resellers.

🔢 Typical Dosing
Most Fusion bars are divided into small chocolate squares for portioning. Online community discussions commonly mention:


 	1–2 pieces → mild relaxation
 	3–5 pieces → stronger psychoactive effects
 	Full bar → intense effects for experienced users only

💰 Typical Price
Fusion candy-style bars are usually sold online for:


 	Around $20–$40 per bar depending on dosage and retailer.

🧠 Community Reviews
Reddit discussions about the Nerds Fusion bar are highly mixed. Some users reported:


“Lots of body high some visuals.”

Others complained about:


 	Nausea
 	Upset stomach
 	Inconsistent effects
 	Suspicion of synthetic compounds instead of mushrooms

One user specifically noted:


“The nerds ones still taste like puke.”

⚠️ Important Safety Notes
Community reports frequently warn about:


 	Counterfeit Fusion packaging
 	Scam websites
 	Unknown ingredients
 	Fake QR verification systems

Because the mushroom chocolate market is largely unregulated:


 	Verify seller reputation carefully
 	Avoid unusually cheap listings
 	Start with a very low amount if unfamiliar
 	Do not mix with alcohol or other substances

&nbsp;

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion Peanut Butter Cup Bar is a peanut butter–flavored mushroom chocolate bar from the Fusion lineup, designed to taste like a Reese’s-style chocolate treat while delivering a mushroom-infused edible experience. 🥜🍫 What Is Fusion Peanut Butter Cup Bar This bar is part of Fusion’s dessert-inspired collection. It mimics the flavor of a classic peanut butter cup: Milk chocolate shell Creamy peanut butter filling or flavor layer Sweet, candy-like finish Mushroom-infused blend for added “functional” or psychoactive effects depending on the source 🍄 Ingredients (as listed by sellers) Typical listings describe: Cocoa / milk chocolate Peanut butter or peanut butter flavoring Natural sweeteners Mushroom blend or “proprietary infusion” Sometimes added nootropic ingredients for mood or focus claims 🧠 Effects (as marketed online) Depending on the version being sold, sellers describe effects such as: Relaxation Mood elevation Light euphoria Increased sensory perception Some versions are marketed more as functional mushroom/nootropic chocolate , while others are labeled more like psychedelic-style edibles , but consistency varies widely across vendors. 💰 Price Range Most listings show : Around $20–$30 per bar depending on seller and dosage claims ⚠️ Important Reality Check Fusion Peanut Butter Cup Bar Fusion-branded mushroom bars are widely sold through unofficial websites and resellers , which means: Ingredients can vary a lot between sellers Some products may not contain real mushrooms Counterfeit packaging is common Potency and safety are not standardized 🔥 Bottom line It’s essentially a peanut butter cup–flavored mushroom chocolate edible , popular because it tastes familiar and sweet, but the quality and contents depend heavily on where it’s purchased .

fusion-pretzel-sea-salt-chocolate-bar.name: Fusion Pretzel Sea Salt Chocolate Bar

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion Pretzel Sea Salt Chocolate Bar Fusion Pretzel Sea Salt Chocolate Bar” represents a contemporary evolution in the confectionery industry, characterized by the deliberate pairing of contrasting flavor profiles—specifically the interplay between sweet, savory, and textural elements. In the study of food science and culinary arts, this combination is often categorized under the principle of “flavor balancing,” where the addition of sodium chloride (sea salt) serves to enhance the perception of sweetness while simultaneously mitigating the cloying nature of high-sugar content in milk or dark chocolate. The structural integrity of such a bar relies on the tempering process of the cocoa butter, which ensures a stable crystalline structure (Form V crystals) that provides the characteristic “snap” when broken. The inclusion of pretzels introduces a distinct textural contrast, known in food science as “mouthfeel,” which breaks the homogeneity of the chocolate matrix. The salt crystals, often applied as a finishing touch or integrated into the pretzel component, act as a flavor potentiator. By stimulating the taste receptors on the tongue, salt increases the overall intensity of the chocolate’s flavor profile , a phenomenon extensively documented in the sensory analysis of modern confectionery products. From a manufacturing perspective, the “fusion” aspect refers to the industrial challenge of maintaining the crispness of the pretzel within a high-moisture or fat-based environment. If the pretzel is not properly coated or if the chocolate contains excessive moisture, the starch in the pretzel will absorb the water, leading to a loss of structural integrity and a “soggy” texture. Consequently, high-quality fusion bars utilize moisture-barrier technologies or specific lipid-based coatings on the pretzel inclusions to preserve the crunch that defines the consumer experience .

 	Dark chocolate base (usually 55–70% cocoa)
 	Raspberry flavoring or freeze-dried raspberry pieces
 	Sweet + tart berry profile
 	Smooth or slightly crunchy texture depending on formulation

🍓 Flavor Profile

 	Rich cocoa bitterness from dark chocolate
 	Bright, tangy raspberry sweetness
 	Slight fruity acidity for balance
 	Dessert-like “chocolate + berries” taste

It’s a common gourmet pairing used in many artisan chocolates because raspberry naturally enhances dark chocolate’s fruit notes.

🧠 Why people like it

 	Strong contrast of sweet and bitter flavors
 	Feels less heavy than pure chocolate bars
 	Fruity taste helps mask strong cocoa bitterness
 	Popular among people who prefer “refined” chocolate flavors

💰 Typical price range
Depending on brand and quality:


 	About $10–$20 for standard artisan bars
 	Higher-end organic versions can go slightly above that

🔥 Simple breakdown
The Bar is essentially:
A dark chocolate bar infused with raspberry flavor or pieces, designed to taste rich, fruity, and slightly tangy.

reference.sourceFullDescription: Raspberry Goji Gummy Fusion Raspberry Goji Gummy is a superfruit-inspired infused gummy that combines tart raspberry flavor with earthy-sweet goji berry for a more wellness-focused edible experience. 🍓🫐 Flavor Profile Fusion Raspberry Goji Gummy Fusion describes the flavor as: Bright tart raspberry Mildly earthy goji berry Jam-like fruity sweetness Slight herbal undertones Soft chewy gummy texture The combination is designed to taste more like a gourmet fruit blend than a standard candy gummy. 🍄 What’s Inside Fusion Raspberry Goji Gummy According to online product listings, the gummies may include: Raspberry puree Goji berry extract Nano-emulsified hemp or cannabinoid extract Pectin (vegan gummy base) Natural fruit-derived coloring Some sellers market the gummies as: Vegan-friendly Gluten-free Wellness-oriented Fast-acting infused gummies 🧠 Marketed Effects Fusion markets Raspberry Goji gummies for: Calm focus Mood elevation Stress reduction Mental clarity Light body relaxation The product is commonly promoted for: yoga mindfulness creative work journaling daytime wellness routines ⚡ Infusion Technology The gummies are advertised as using: nano-emulsified infusion technology Fusion claims this may provide: faster onset (around 30–45 minutes) smoother absorption more predictable effects 💰 Price Current online pricing: around $20 per pouch on Fusion-branded stores 🗣️ Community Feedback Online discussions about Fusion gummies are mixed. One Reddit user said: “you’ll probably have a pretty good high” Another reported weaker effects from gummies compared to Fusion chocolate bars: “we didn’t feel anything from them” ⚠️ Important Safety Notes Fusion Raspberry Goji Gummy Many “Fusion” infused gummies online are sold through unofficial websites and resellers. Potency, ingredients, and quality may vary significantly between batches and sellers . Community discussions frequently warn about: inconsistent dosing copied packaging unclear ingredient sourcing If trying infused gummies : start with a low amount wait before re-dosing avoid mixing with alcohol or other substances keep away from children and pets

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion Rocky Rodeo Chocolate Bar is a dessert-style chocolate bar inspired by the classic “rocky road” flavor — a mix of chocolate, marshmallow, and crunchy nuts. 🍫 What it is Fusion Rocky Rodeo Chocolate Bar This bar is designed around the traditional rocky road dessert concept , which is known for combining: Smooth chocolate base Soft marshmallows Crunchy nuts (like almonds or peanuts) Sweet, creamy dessert-style taste The result is a rich, textured chocolate bar with both chewiness and crunch in every bite. 🍬 Flavor Profile Sweet milk chocolate Fluffy marshmallow pieces Nutty crunch (varies by batch) Slight caramel-like sweetness in some versions Overall “dessert mix” flavor experience 🧠 Concept Origin Fusion Rocky Rodeo Chocolate Bar The name “Rocky Road” comes from a classic American dessert created in the 1920s, traditionally made with chocolate, marshmallows, and nuts mixed together . 💡 Why people like it Multiple textures in one bar (soft + crunchy + creamy) Very sweet, dessert-like taste Familiar “comfort food” flavor Appeals to people who don’t like bitter dark chocolate 💰 Typical price Usually around $15–$25 per bar depending on seller and packaging style ⚠️ Important note “Fusion” branded mushroom chocolate products are widely sold through different unofficial websites , so: ingredients can vary by seller quality is not always consistent packaging may be copied or resold

reference.sourceFullDescription: Fusion Sour Apple Gummy is a sour green-apple–flavored infused gummy from the Fusion-style edible lineup, designed to deliver a sharp candy taste with a strong, fast-acting edible effect depending on the formulation. 🍏 Flavor Profile Fusion Sour Apple Gummy This gummy is built around a classic sour candy experience: Sharp green apple tartness Sweet candy finish Slightly fruity, Jolly Rancher–style taste Chewy gummy texture The goal is a strong “sour hit first, sweet aftertaste” profile that masks the stronger infused ingredients. ⚡ Potency & Type (varies by version) Different “Fusion Sour Apple” products exist, but some versions are marketed as very high potency infused gummies , containing blends such as: THC-P THC-V Delta-8 / Delta-9 THC HHC Full-spectrum cannabinoids Some are described as “high tolerance only” products , meaning they are significantly stronger than standard gummies. 🧠 Reported Effects Fusion Sour Apple Gummy (user descriptions) Depending on the version, users typically report: Strong relaxation Body-heavy calm feeling Euphoric mood lift Slow, long-lasting onset (often 1–2 hours) Stronger effects at higher doses Some listings emphasize a “full-body, mind-altering experience” for experienced users only. 💰 Typical Price Around $10–$40 per pack , depending on potency and brand version High-strength ISO-blend versions tend to be more expensive ⚠️ Important reality check “Fusion” gummies are not a single standardized regulated product line . The name is widely used across different sellers, so: potency can vary a lot between batches ingredients may differ depending on the vendor labeling may not always match contents That’s why experiences reported online are inconsistent . 🧾 Simple explanation The Gummy is basically: a sour green-apple candy-style gummy that’s often infused with strong cannabinoid blends, known for intense effects and a tart, Jolly Rancher-like flavor.

rawPayload.fullDescription: Fusion Watermelon Gummy Fusion Watermelon Gummy is a watermelon-flavored infused gummy designed to taste like fresh, juicy watermelon candy while delivering a relaxing, mood-enhancing edible experience depending on the formula used. 🍉 Flavor Profile Fusion Watermelon Gummy This gummy is built around a classic summer fruit flavor: Sweet ripe watermelon taste Light citrus or candy undertones Juicy, refreshing finish Soft chewy gummy texture It’s often described as tasting like: watermelon candy fruit punch gummies chilled summer watermelon slices 🧠 Reported Effects (varies by version) Depending on the specific “Fusion” product line, watermelon gummies are marketed for: Relaxation Mood uplift Stress relief Light euphoria Calm, social energy Some stronger versions (especially cannabinoid blends) are described as having more intense body effects and longer duration . ⚡ Strength & Formulation Variations “Fusion Watermelon Gummies” are not a single standardized product, so you may see different types : Functional mushroom blends (mild wellness focus) Hemp/cannabinoid gummies (moderate to strong effects) High-potency THC blend versions (strong, psychoactive effects) This is why experiences online can differ a lot between users. 💰 Typical Price Around $20–$40 per pack depending on potency and seller ⚠️ Important note Fusion Watermelon Gummy Many “Fusion” branded gummies are sold through unofficial online shops and resellers , so: potency can vary significantly ingredients may differ between batches packaging can be copied or resold 🧾 Simple explanation The Gummy is basically: a watermelon candy-style gummy that may contain infused mushroom or cannabinoid blends, designed for a sweet taste with relaxing or uplifting effects.
